request.description: Starts an import for a `.csv` or `.xlsx` file and returns a short-lived upload URL. PUT the file there with the returned headers (it goes straight to private storage, not through the API), then call Inspect. Files: CSV up to 50 MB / 200,000 rows, XLSX up to 20 MB. Staff only. Reading needs import read access (ops lead, compliance); running needs import manage access (ops lead, super admin).

response.name: 201 Created
